record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: sharp p-to-1 behavior in fractional degree estimates
record.original_question: For maps f in W^{1/p,p}(S^1; S^1), with 1 < p <= 2, does there exist a universal constant c such that the degree satisfies |deg f| <= c (p-1) integral_{S^1} integral_{S^1} |f(x)-f(y)|^p / |x-y|^2 dx dy for every such f?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 5.1 ([17, Remark 7]). Does there exist a (universal) constant c such that, for every 1 < p <= 2, inequality (5.2) holds?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S^1$ denote the unit circle in $\mathbb{R}^2$, equipped with arclength measure. For $1<p\le 2$, consider the fractional Sobolev space $W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1)$ consisting of measurable maps $f:S^1\to S^1\subset\mathbb{C}$ such that the Gagliardo seminorm
$$[f]_{1/p,p}^p:=\int_{S^1}\int_{S^1}\frac{|f(x)-f(y)|^p}{|x-y|^2}\,dx\,dy$$
is finite. It is known that every such map $f$ has a well-defined integer topological degree $\deg f\in\mathbb{Z}$, and that there exists a constant $C_p$ (depending on $p$) such that
$$|\deg f|\le C_p\,[f]_{1/p,p}^p\qquad\text{for all }f\in W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1).$$
Question: Does there exist a universal constant $c>0$, independent of $p$, such that the sharper estimate
$$|\deg f|\le c\,(p-1)\int_{S^1}\int_{S^1}\frac{|f(x)-f(y)|^p}{|x-y|^2}\,dx\,dy$$
holds for every $1<p\le 2$ and every $f\in W^{1/p,p}(S^1;S^1)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the area of fractional Sobolev degree estimates on the circle. Web searches for "Bourgain–Brezis–Nguyen" type degree estimates with the sharp $(p-1)$ factor did not produce any published resolution; related work continues on BBM-type formulas and sharp constants, but the specific universal-constant inequality with the linear $(p-1)$ prefactor for the degree on $S^1$ appears to remain unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Lifting, Degree, and Distributional Jacobian Revisited (Bourgain–Brezis–Mironescu)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies degree of maps in fractional Sobolev spaces W^{s,p} into S^1 and related estimates.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the W^{1/p,p} framework for degree but does not establish the universal (p-1) constant version.

status_evidence.title: A surprising formula for Sobolev norms (Brezis–Van Schaftingen–Yung)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses sharp asymptotic constants in fractional Gagliardo seminorms as p approaches limits.
status_evidence.claim: Related sharp-constant program, but does not resolve the universal $(p-1)$ degree inequality on $S^1$.
